quest:Woodlin_Elder1.name: Portal_Issues
quest:Woodlin_Elder1.description: Defeat 400,000 Woodlin Spirits to open the portal, business as usual, forget this Elder chump!

quest:Woodlin_Elder2.name: Big_Lock_Picking
quest:Woodlin_Elder2.description: Defeat 400,000 Woodlin Spirits on a 2nd character, that must be what the big lock is all about!

quest:Woodlin_Elder3.name: Fiddy
quest:Woodlin_Elder3.description: Defeat exactly 50 Woodlin Spirits. Stand on the top right platform to lock in your killcount. Killcount resets if incorrect.

quest:Woodlin_Elder4.name: Hunned_Fiddy
quest:Woodlin_Elder4.description: Defeat exactly 150 Woodlin Spirits. Stand on the top right platform to lock in your killcount. Killcount resets if incorrect.

quest:Woodlin_Elder5.name: Triple_Tre
quest:Woodlin_Elder5.description: Defeat exactly 333 Woodlin Spirits. Stand on the top right platform to lock in your killcount. Killcount resets if incorrect.

item:Gfoodcoupon.name: Gold_Food_Coupon
item:Gfoodcoupon.description: Hold down to receive a random golden food!

item:ExpBalloon3.name: Large_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon3.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:GemP30.name: Sand_of_Time
item:GemP30.description: Hold down instantly gain 6 Hours of Sneaking Progress! Applies to all your ninja twins, so it doesn't matter who uses this.

item:Quest81.name: Compost_Bag
item:Quest81.description: Hold down instantly gain 4 Hours of Farming Progress!

pageProps.seoDescription: Woodlin Elder is a Legends of Idleon NPC: quest reward, 5 quests.
